customers_say: Customers find the smart lock to be of high quality, with all features working smoothly and providing excellent value for money. They appreciate its ease of use, security features, and premium appearance, with one customer noting its secure multi-bolt system. The lock offers versatile access methods, and while battery life is generally good, some customers report it lasting only one year.
